name: Hala-1.2B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Arabic-centric instruction finetune of LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B (SFT on hammh0a/Hala-4.6M-SFT), same config.json and tensor set as the base. Recorded as a contender because the card prints one table in which the base row (LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B) and the Hala-1.2B row sit side by side on six Arabic benchmarks plus an Average column, and Hala-1.2B wins all seven. Evaluated with lighteval on ArabicMMLU (OALL-2) excluding AlRage, per the card's stated protocol. The thinnest win is ArbMMLU-HT at +0.8 (43.4 vs 44.2); the largest is EXAMS at +8.4. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0 - non-commercial - repo created 2025-09-13. Companion sizes 350M/700M/9B exist in the same collection and are not recorded here.
